target_customer: Companies spending on LLM APIs that want lower cost, and later firms that want models they own
problem: Teams overpay by sending every LLM request to a frontier model, and they build no owned intelligence from their repeated workloads.
business_model: Usage based API gateway with a path to private models trained on customer workloads
product_category: LLM routing gateway and independent AI research lab

founders.name: Carl Stauffer
education: Computer science and applied mathematics, Johns Hopkins
founders.background_notes: From the YC page. Also an a16z Scout and Palantir's first Neurodivergent Fellow per the page. YC lists a team of five but names only him as founder.

competitors.name: OpenRouter
competitors.what: Multi model inference gateway and marketplace
competitors.funding_then: 113M USD Series B at 1.3B USD valuation

competitors.name: Martian
competitors.what: Model router focused on cost optimization
competitors.funding_then: About 9M USD, a low confidence estimate

technical_complexity.rationale: Routing each request to the cheapest capable model requires reliable quality evaluation, and training private models on open weights requires real research.

defensibility.rationale: A gateway is a one line change to adopt and to leave. Value could compound from routing and workload data, but no evidence of that yet.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: OpenRouter raised a large round in May 2026, and a Pitchbook piece asks if routers are a dead end. No acquisition of Riften found.

market_need_then: Token bills rise with agent usage and trade press in 2026 covers routers as a response. The company shows no customer figures on its site.

identity.logo: Mark with light and dark variants
identity.visual_style: Research lab style site with About, Research and Careers pages

brand_strength.rationale: A distinct tagline and lab positioning, but no outside coverage of the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: Riften is an active Summer 2026 company with no verified funding. It sits in a crowded routing market led by OpenRouter and tries to differentiate with owned private models. The founder's Palantir deployment experience helps with enterprise work, but adoption, moat and quality evaluation are unproven at this stage.
notes: Unverified: Dealroom lists a 125K USD seed with no investor or date, AI generated page, not recorded as a round. TrustedRouter and Concentrate AI are later or unrelated entrants and are not listed as competitors at founding. Name origin not found. Outcome search found no news.
